title: Work orders View OFF makes work order lines unreachable
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders View OFF.
custom_steps: 1. Log in and look at the top navigation.
custom_expected: Work Orders is hidden, so there is no way to reach any work order and therefore no way to reach work order lines.
evidence: UI (Sales Rep = no workOrdersView): Work Orders is hidden from nav and /workorders redirects to /reports, so no work order (and therefore no work order lines) is reachable. WO View OFF makes WO lines unreachable.
